description: Single-file tower defense: grid map with buildable cells and a fixed enemy path, 3+ tower types with ranges/fire rates/upgrade levels, wave scripting with scaling, money economy with kill bounties, range preview, speed control, lives, game over, localStorage best wave.

criteria: tower_defense_model_01.html is one self-contained tower defense (no libraries): a grid map where buildable cells and the enemy path are visually distinct, at least 3 tower types with different range, fire rate, damage and projectile behavior (at least one slow or splash tower), upgrades that meaningfully improve each stat, scripted waves with scaling counts and at least two enemy classes (fast, tanky), money earned from kills spent on build/upgrade, a range circle preview on selection, targeting that prioritizes the furthest-progressed enemy, lives, start/pause and 1x/2x speed controls, game over and a best-wave record in localStorage. All combat math must be real.
